site: iCIMS / Mutual of Enumclaw; shared authentication and handoff paths
class: Sanitized stop artifacts omit structural evidence needed to diagnose a silent form stall
symptom: Mutual of Enumclaw profile stays open without a visible error according to the owner; saved screenshots are fully masked and text exports hide most labels and values.
root_cause: Stop capture saves masked image/text only; browser validity flags, disabled submit state and browser guard denial kinds are not captured alongside the stop.
why_tests_missed: Privacy tests enforce redaction but do not require useful structural evidence for silent authentication stalls.
fix: Write a bounded .state.json alongside stop and account-failure evidence. Persist only booleans, counts and known validity/denial enums from non-challenge frames; no labels, values, URLs, secrets or CAPTCHA contents.
prevention: Preserve decision-relevant structural facts when text and screenshots must be redacted.
